mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.artist_id, a.name AS artist_name, p.sub_category_id, sc.name AS sub_category_name, p.name, p.description, p.thumbnail_image, p.is_active FROM products p JOIN artists a ON p.artist_id = a.id JOIN sub_categories sc ON p.sub_category_id = sc.id WHERE p.is_active = 1 AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.created_at DESC

SELECT p.id, p.artist_id, a.name AS artist_name, p.sub_category_id, sc.name AS sub_category_name, p.name, p.description, p.thumbnail_image, p.is_active FROM products p JOIN artists a ON p.artist_id = a.id JOIN sub_categories sc ON p.sub_category_id = sc.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT id, product_id, name, price, is_active FROM product_options WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY id ASC
